thread:
Leigh (CSM): Morning — heads up: billing-bot flagged a PAYG surge for MaplePark (acct_mp_1987). Their hosted usage jumped past ~130% of monthly commit overnight. https://console.redwood.ai/account/mp_1987/usage :eyes:

billing-bot: :warning: Alert: PAYG spike detected for MaplePark (mp_1987) — usage 2.8x expected window; rule=payg-commit-cross. Details: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/az3f2

Sam (Finance): ugh — is that forecast or actual? can you post delta by endpoint/model?

Leigh (CSM): actual tokens. quick top-level: gen endpoints + embeddings are up. quick query I ran:
```
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS spend
FROM usage
WHERE account_id='mp_1987' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY spend DESC;
```

Aisha (Customer Success): looping in @Devon for infra/latency check. If this is embeddings-heavy we might want to temporarily throttle.

Devon (SRE): checked infra — latency and error rates look stable. 95p latency ~85ms; no retry storms. Appears to be a user-driven batch job. I'll pull source IPs and UA.

Sam (Finance): do we have their commit + paygo thresholds? are they on soft-commit? want to understand renewal risk.

Leigh (CSM): They have a $50k/mo commit + paygo top-up. Commit usage pre-spike was 30% for the month; the overnight spike added ~$6.2k in paygo in the last 24h.

Aisha (Customer Success): Proposed actions:
1) Quick sync with MaplePark PM to confirm whether a new job was kicked off.
2) Offer a short-term burst cap + optional courtesy credit if it was accidental.
3) If intentional, discuss commit bump for next cycle.
Assign: Leigh -> contact customer, Sam -> estimate finance impact, Devon -> add temp quota rule.

Leigh (CSM): reaching out now -> "@MaplePark-ops Could you confirm any new data-processing jobs started in last 36h? We saw a large embeddings + gen spike and wanted to check before billing"

billing-bot: Note: Automated invoice estimate updated — projected month-end PAYG spend for mp_1987 now $18,450 (was $12,200). Notification sent to billing-alerts.

Devon (SRE): FYI pulling IPs and user-agent list now. If we need to throttle, recommended per-route limit: /v1/embeddings-heavy -> 10-15 r/s for mp_1987.

Sam (Finance): running a scenario calc — if this spike persists at 3x current rate we exhaust commit by day ~12 this month. Could force a mid-cycle renewal conversation.

Aisha (Customer Success): tagging @michelle_sales for potential renewal touch if this becomes persistent.

michelle_sales: thx — keep me in the loop. If commit looks undersized we can discuss a mid-cycle uplift; that usually closes quickly.

Leigh (CSM): update after 30m — MaplePark replied: they deployed a new vector-indexing cron and it duplicated runs accidentally. They asked for a one-time courtesy credit.

Sam (Finance): can we grant a partial credit? what's allowed under policy?

Leigh (CSM): policy notes: one small courtesy credit allowed for onboarding issues; this is accidental ops. propose a 20% credit on the paygo overage, capped at $2k.

Aisha (Customer Success): I support a small credit to preserve relationship. Sam, can you process approval or escalate to finance-ops?

Sam (Finance): will prep approval note and ping finance-ops. give me ~2h.

Devon (SRE): applied a temporary rate-limit for mp_1987 on embeddings endpoint: 15 r/s, monitoring for 1h and collecting UA/IPs.

Leigh (CSM): thanks all — I'll follow up in 24h with updated spend delta and a short note to the account health dashboard. :thumbsup:
